question: Should the design-system updater be enabled by making `openclaw/design-system` public, by giving this workflow an explicit read credential/app token, or by pausing the scheduled updater until that repository policy changes?
rationale: The workflow cannot perform its central hosted behavior with the default token today, and the safe credential/public-repo choice is an organization/security decision rather than a code-only fix.

options.title: Keep Draft Until Access Is Resolved
options.body: Leave this PR open as a draft and mark it ready only after either public release access or a scoped read credential is available and the hosted updater run succeeds.

options.title: Use A Scoped Credential
options.body: Add a narrowly scoped GitHub App or secret-backed token for reading `openclaw/design-system`, then have secops review the scheduled write workflow before merge.

options.title: Pause Scheduled Automation
options.body: Close or park the updater if the design-system repository will remain private without a consumer credential for the near term.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft Until Access Is Resolved
recommendation.body: Leave this PR open as a draft and mark it ready only after either public release access or a scoped read credential is available and the hosted updater run succeeds.
